items.headline: Solana disinflation proposal SGP-0002 narrowly leads while fee-burn proposal remains below threshold
items.summary: CoinDesk reports all three Solana governance proposals have cleared quorum. SGP-0002, which would accelerate reductions in new SOL issuance, has 68.77% support versus the two-thirds threshold, while SGP-0003 has 62.72% support and remains below the threshold; voting is still open.
items.whyItMatters: If the faster-disinflation mandate passes, future SOL issuance would decline more quickly, reducing dilution; however the vote is not final and implementation would still require separate technical work.
items.actionReason: The governance development is fundamental context only and cannot create a Crypto Reca buy signal. The latest available Radar is stale at Aug. 26 20:01 Madrid and had SOL ERS 49 / Entry 1/5 / WATCH with no completed trigger.

items.headline: Bitcoin treasury-company model unwinds as top holders turn net sellers
items.summary: Financial Times analysis found the 50 largest bitcoin-treasury companies shifted to net selling in July, selling about 2,500 more BTC than they bought; Strategy sold nearly 7,000 BTC between late June and mid-August to fund interest-bearing obligations.
items.whyItMatters: Corporate treasury buyers had been an incremental source of BTC demand; a shift by large holders toward net selling and balance-sheet deleveraging can remove demand and create supply overhang.
items.actionReason: This is a structural institutional-flow warning, not an exit instruction. The latest Crypto Reca Radar is stale at Aug. 26 20:01 Madrid and had BTC ERS 49 / Entry 1/5 / HOLD EXISTING CORE / NO ADD.
